# Vent Busters

> Vent Busters provides dryer vent and air duct services for homeowners across Palm Beach County and the Treasure Coast, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie.

## Company Facts
- Name: Vent Busters
- Phone: (561) 884-4648
- Email: Ventsbusters@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.vent-busters.com/
- Service area: Palm Beach County & the Treasure Coast — Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie (20 communities). Service-area business; no separate offices in these cities.
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 7am–6pm, Friday 7am–3pm; closed Saturday and Sunday
- Pricing: No published flat rate — quoted after an evaluation, explained before work begins
- Credentials: Insured and trained technicians. Vent Busters does not claim any contractor license or certification.
- Guarantee: Not satisfied? Tell us within 14 days and we'll re-clean the accessible components at no charge, or refund that service.

## Services
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-cleaning.html): Cleaning of the accessible dryer exhaust pathway; rotary brush and vacuum; airflow check.
- [Dryer Vent Blockage Removal](https://www.vent-busters.com/dryer-vent-blockage-removal.html): Locating and removing accessible obstructions in a severely restricted or blocked vent.
- [Air Duct Cleaning](https://www.vent-busters.com/air-duct-cleaning.html): Cleaning of accessible supply and return ductwork, registers and grilles. No health or air-quality claims are made.
- [HVAC UV Light Systems](https://www.vent-busters.com/uv-light-installation.html): Supply and installation of UV systems for compatible HVAC equipment, per manufacturer requirements.
- [HVAC System Sanitization](https://www.vent-busters.com/hvac-system-sanitization.html): Optional treatment applied per product label after appropriate cleaning. Not mold assessment or remediation.

## Common Questions
- How much does it cost? No published flat rate. Pricing depends on the system and is explained before work begins.
- Does Vent Busters do mold assessment or remediation? No. If we observe material that may require mold assessment we recommend evaluation by an appropriately licensed professional.
- Is Vent Busters a licensed HVAC contractor? No such claim is made on the site.
- Do you offer same-day service? Same-day and next-day appointments may be available depending on technician availability and location.
- What areas do you serve? The 20 communities listed below, from Boca Raton to Port St. Lucie.
